purpose: Hypothetical few-shot behavior demonstrations; not evaluations or execution evidence.

input.scenario: A hypothetical challenge asserts severe demand loss without source evidence or a labeled scenario assumption.

expected_behavior: Recast it as a testable hypothesis if relevant.
Request discriminating evidence without inventing a downside estimate.
cases.expected_response_excerpt: Identify the claim as unsupported. Recast it as a testable hypothesis if relevant. Request discriminating evidence without inventing a downside estimate.

input.scenario: A hypothetical optimistic and pessimistic case both depend on the same unverified customer-retention claim.

expected_behavior: Prioritize verification of the shared premise.
Do not present agreement across scenarios as independent corroboration.
cases.expected_response_excerpt: Expose the common dependency. Prioritize verification of the shared premise. Do not present agreement across scenarios as independent corroboration.

input.scenario: A hypothetical challenger wrote the original investment thesis and is asked to independently clear it.

expected_behavior: Limit their work to an identified self-challenge.
Require another eligible reviewer for independent judgment.
cases.expected_response_excerpt: Disclose contribution to the thesis. Limit their work to an identified self-challenge. Require another eligible reviewer for independent judgment.
